guide: Start
Enter each order once on Orders. Enter its SKU lines on Order Lines. Keep order numbers, SKUs, GTINs and directory codes as text, including leading zeroes.
Blank fields
Excel values come first. Blank fields use available Analytics, Product Master, Directory and app defaults. Each field shows its source in the upload review and can be edited there.
Source decisions
Review defaults field by field. Keep Excel for one value and choose Analytics or Product Master for another. Missing inputs and conflicting defaults are highlighted. Recalculate after editing.
Multiple records
Use Analytics Record ID when a sales order number is reused. Otherwise select the correct record in the discrepancy popup.
Quantities
Ordered Quantity is the quantity sold in Ordered Unit. Auto follows the matching level SKU. Eaches Per Case is a unit count, not pounds. Gross box weight includes packaging.
Custom packing

Choose Units per box, Pounds per box or Total boxes, enter Packing Value and the actual box dimensions/gross weight. Pounds per ordered unit is needed for weight packing and unequal final boxes. Original demand is preserved.
Labels

Labels is optional. Leave it blank to use enabled Product Master templates. To choose outputs explicitly, add one row per SKU/packaging level/template. Repeat a SKU for multiple templates. Copies, lot, dates and pack wording apply to that label row.
Line IDs
Use unique Line IDs within an order. If the same SKU has multiple configurations or lines, repeat its Line ID on Labels so the correct line is used.
Addresses
Choose a Directory Code or enter a full multiline address. Ship From, Bill To and Ship To are separate. Draft/incomplete Directory records are not automatic defaults.
Outputs

Packing List and Ti-Hi and Pallet Labels default to Yes. Customer Labels defaults to Auto. Select No to exclude an output. Add a shipping Case or custom box measurements when pallet calculation is required.
Review

Fix missing inputs in the app without uploading again. Use Edit fields and defaults to return after calculation. Review match notices and document warnings before generating. Download reviewed Excel to retain corrections.
ZIP contents
One ZIP contains order-number folders with selected PDFs, the source workbook, reviewed inputs with edits, and field-level source decisions. This batch does not change Product Master or Directory.
Dropdowns
Dropdown choices are refreshed when downloading from the app. New SKUs/customers can still be typed and will be checked on upload. Yes/No lists are used for broad Excel compatibility.
Limits
Up to 100 orders and 5,000 order lines per upload. Template input rows include dropdowns through row 5,001. Keep sheet names and header labels unchanged.
Field help

All dimensions are inches and all shipping weights are pounds. Ship Date, Expected Delivery Date, PO Date, Expiration Date and Best Before accept Excel dates or YYYY-MM-DD. Label templates and document layouts are separate choices.
